Id1.text: Abraham A. Ribicoff was in office while John F. Kennedy was president and his spouse was a woman called Ruth Ribicoff. He was an American citizen and worked as the United States Secretary of Health, Education and Welfare. He was succeeded in office by John N Dempsey.

Id2.text: Abraham A. Ribicoff was married to Ruth Ribicoff and was in office at the same time as John F. Kennedy was president. He was a citizen of the USA and was succeeded by John N. Dempsey in his office of the United States Secretary of Health, Education, and Welfare.

Id3.text: American citizen Abraham A. Ribicoff worked for the United States Secretary of Health, Education, and Welfare office during John F. Kennedy’s presidency. He was succeeded in his role by John N. Dempsey and was the husband of Ruth Ribicoff.
